data.name: AstroBoost
data.detailed_description:
AstroBoost is a fast-paced side-scrolling arcade action game inspired by classic arcade experiences.

Control an astronaut using simple one-touch controls:

• Tap to jump

• Hold to activate your boost

• Automatically destroy obstacles with your weapon

Navigate dangerous space environments filled with asteroids, traps, and enemies.

Easy to learn, difficult to master.

Challenge yourself across multiple stages, improve your skills, and aim for the highest score.

Features:

• Simple one-touch controls

• Fast-paced arcade gameplay

• Multiple challenging stages

• Online leaderboards

• Retro-inspired action

• Quick sessions, endless retries

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a Mac with Apple silicon
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU or later
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Game controllers are not supported
